title: TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity
abstract: arXiv:2610.07559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent progress in tabular foundation models suggests that training on synthetic tasks can substantially improve in-context learning capabilities, with overall performance largely depending on how well models can infer task-specific predictive relationships from the available context during inference. In this paper, we introduce TAFFY, a tabular foundation model with an In-Context Diversity Prior and a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that strengthen this ability. Specifically, to construct each synthetic pretraining context, the In-Context Diversity Prior samples from multiple related environments derived via controlled interventions and distribution shifts on a shared causal process. This in-context diversity encourages the model to learn a more comprehensive and task-specific representation. Moreover, the Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer iteratively and selectively applies a shared group of Transformer blocks to refine contextua

translated_title: TAFFY：一种具有上下文内多样性的任务自适应表格基础模型
translated_abstract: 近年表格基础模型的研究进展表明，在合成任务上进行训练能够显著提升模型的上下文内学习能力，而整体性能在很大程度上取决于模型在推理时能否从可用上下文中准确推断出任务特定的预测关系。在本文中，我们提出了TAFFY，一种带有上下文内多样性先验和任务条件循环Transformer的表格基础模型，用以强化这一能力。具体而言，为构建每个合成预训练上下文，上下文内多样性先验从多个相关环境中进行采样，这些环境是通过对共享因果过程施加受控干预和分布偏移而生成的。这种上下文内多样性促使模型学习到更全面且任务特定的表示。此外，任务条件循环Transformer迭代且选择性地应用一组共享的Transformer模块来精炼上下文信息（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: TAFFY通过基于共享因果过程干预生成多样化合成上下文的“上下文内多样性先验”和迭代精炼的任务条件循环Transformer，显著提升了表格基础模型从上下文推断任务特定预测关系的能力。
en_tdlr: TAFFY is a tabular foundation model that improves in-context task inference by combining an In-Context Diversity Prior, which generates diverse synthetic pretraining contexts via controlled interventions on a shared causal process, with a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that iteratively refines contextual representations.
